messages.subject: newbie question about updating plots
parts:
Hi I'm trying to create an app that allows me to select different IVs and DVs from drop down lists then plot them using ggplot2.  I'd also like to plot an interaction between a continuous and binary variable so I'm trying to write code that says "if interaction is selected from IV drop down make this plot (map color to binary variable) , otherwise make these other kinds of plots (bivariate scatter)".  I can get both types of plots to appear in shiny but only if I set them as the default beforehand, otherwise I get the following error:
 
Warning in Ops.factor(NumSwitch, CF2) : * not meaningful for factors
Warning in Ops.factor(NumSwitch, CF2) : * not meaningful for factors
Error in if (zero_range(from) || zero_range(to)) return(rep(mean(to),  : 
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

I don't receive the error when I remove the user input variables and run the plots within R.  This seems like a reactivity problem, but I'm not sure how to address it.  The specific code I'm wrestling with is bolded below.

Thanks in advance for the help!

-Christian

ui
library(shiny)

# Define UI for scatterplot and summary application
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  
  # Application title
  headerPanel("CF Puzzle"),
  
# Drop down list of dependent variables to be plotted
  sidebarPanel(
    selectInput("DV", "DV list:",
                 list("seconds" = "AvgOverallTime",
                      "log seconds" = "l.AvgOverallTime")
                 ),
 # Drop down list of independent variables to be plotted,
# NumSwitch*CF2 is an interaction term that needs to be plotted differently than the other bi-variate models
    selectInput("IV", "IV list:",
                list("NumSwitch" = "NumSwitch",
                     "TMT" = "CF2",
                     "NumSwitch*CF2" = "NumSwitch*CF2")
    ),
    checkboxInput("fit.line", "Fit Line", F) #add a trend line 
    
    
  ),
  
  mainPanel(
    h3(textOutput("caption")), # put formula here
    
    plotOutput("puzzPlot"), # single plot
    
    verbatimTextOutput("summary") # verbatim output from 'lm' summary
  )
  ))


server
library(shiny)

# data
dat <- read.csv("~/Desktop/test3.csv") 
dat$l.AvgOverallTime <- log(dat$AvgOverallTime) # create log transformed DV
dat$CF2 <- factor(dat$CF2, labels = c("High","Low")) # make this a factor

# Define server logic required to plot various IVs and DVs
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  formulaText <- reactive({
    paste(input$DV,"~",input$IV) #make formula string
  })
  
  # Return the formula text for printing as a caption
  output$caption <- renderText({
   formulaText() # print that as text over the plot
    
  })

  output$puzzPlot <- renderPlot({
    library(ggplot2)
# Interaction plot
    if(input$IV == "NumSwitch*CF2"){
      aes_mapping1 <- aes_string(x = "NumSwitch", y = input$DV, color = "CF2") # create aesthetics string from selected DV using fixed IVs
      p <- ggplot(dat, mapping = aes_mapping1 )
      p <- p + geom_point()
      if(input$fit.line){
        p = p + stat_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE) # if fit line is checked then add a trend line otherwise nothing
      }
      print(p)
      
    }
# Bivariate plots
    aes_mapping <- aes_string(x = input$IV, y = input$DV) # create aesthetics string from selected IVs and DVs
    q <- ggplot(dat, mapping = aes_mapping )
    q <- q + geom_point()
    if(input$fit.line){
      q = q + stat_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE) # if fit line is checked then add a trend line otherwise nothing
    }
    print(q)
  })
  
  output$summary <- renderPrint({
    summary(lm(as.formula(formulaText()), data = dat))
    
})
})
